+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, Mapping, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+AZURE_AI_CONTENT_SAFETY_ENDPOINT = os.getenv("AZURE_AI_CONTENT_SAFETY_ENDPOINT", "").rstrip("/")
+AZURE_AI_CONTENT_SAFETY_API_KEY = os.getenv("AZURE_AI_CONTENT_SAFETY_API_KEY", "")
+AZURE_AI_CONTENT_SAFETY_API_VERSION = os.getenv("AZURE_AI_CONTENT_SAFETY_API_VERSION", "2024-09-01")
+
+
+DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS: Dict[str, int] = {
+    "hate": 2,
+    "self_harm": 2,
+    "sexual": 2,
+    "violence": 2,
+}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ThresholdDecision:
+    allow: bool
+    triggered_categories: Dict[str, int]
+    severities: Dict[str, int]
+
+
+def _severity_value(value: Any) -> int:
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return int(value)
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        return int(value)
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        normalized = value.strip().lower()
+        mapping = {"safe": 0, "low": 1, "medium": 2, "high": 3, "very_high": 4}
+        if normalized in mapping:
+            return mapping[normalized]
+        try:
+            return int(float(normalized))
+        except ValueError:
+            return 0
+    return 0
+
+
+def _extract_severities(result: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    severities: Dict[str, int] = {}
+    for category, value in result.items():
+        if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+            for key in ("severity", "level", "score"):
+                if key in value:
+                    severities[category] = _severity_value(value[key])
+                    break
+        else:
+            severities[category] = _severity_value(value)
+    return severities
+
+
+def evaluate_thresholds(
+    moderation_result: Mapping[str, Any],
+    thresholds: Optional[Mapping[str, int]] = None,
+) -> ThresholdDecision:
+    threshold_map = dict(DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS)
+    if thresholds:
+        threshold_map.update({k: int(v) for k, v in thresholds.items()})
+    severities = _extract_severities(moderation_result)
+    triggered = {category: severity for category, severity in severities.items() if severity >= threshold_map.get(category, 999)}
+    return ThresholdDecision(allow=not triggered, triggered_categories=triggered, severities=severities)
+
+
+def _azure_moderate_text(text: str) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    if not AZURE_AI_CONTENT_SAFETY_ENDPOINT or not AZURE_AI_CONTENT_SAFETY_API_KEY:
+        raise RuntimeError("AZURE_AI_CONTENT_SAFETY_ENDPOINT and AZURE_AI_CONTENT_SAFETY_API_KEY are required")
+    url = f"{AZURE_AI_CONTENT_SAFETY_ENDPOINT}/contentsafety/text:analyze?api-version={AZURE_AI_CONTENT_SAFETY_API_VERSION}"
+    response = requests.post(
+        url,
+        headers={
+            "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": AZURE_AI_CONTENT_SAFETY_API_KEY,
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={"text": text},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def apply_thresholds(
+    text: str,
+    thresholds: Optional[Mapping[str, int]] = None,
+    moderation_result: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
+) -> ThresholdDecision:
+    result = moderation_result if moderation_result is not None else _azure_moderate_text(text)
+    return evaluate_thresholds(result, thresholds=thresholds)
+
*** End Patch

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-5.4-mini")
+
+
+def _headers() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    api_key = os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]
+    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
+
+
+def _request_payload(text: str, mode: str = "redact") -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    system = (
+        "You are a moderation assistant. Identify unsafe spans in the input text and either "
+        "flag them with indices or return a redacted version. Respond with JSON only."
+    )
+    user = {
+        "text": text,
+        "mode": mode,
+        "output_schema": {
+            "unsafe_spans": [{"start": 0, "end": 0, "category": "string", "reason": "string"}],
+            "redacted_text": "string",
+            "is_safe": True,
+        },
+    }
+    return {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "messages": [
+            {"role": "system", "content": system},
+            {"role": "user", "content": str(user)},
+        ],
+        "temperature": 0,
+        "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
+    }
+
+
+def redact_unsafe(text: str, mode: str = "redact", timeout: int = 30) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers=_headers(),
+        json=_request_payload(text, mode),
+        timeout=timeout,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+    if isinstance(content, str):
+        import json
+
+        return json.loads(content)
+    return content
+
+
+def flag_unsafe_spans(text: str, timeout: int = 30) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    result = redact_unsafe(text, mode="flag", timeout=timeout)
+    return result.get("unsafe_spans", [])
+
+
+def redact_text(text: str, timeout: int = 30) -> str:
+    result = redact_unsafe(text, mode="redact", timeout=timeout)
+    return result.get("redacted_text", text)
*** End Patch

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+client = OpenAI(api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+
+
+def moderate_batch(messages: List[str]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for message in messages:
+        response = client.moderations.create(
+            model="omni-moderation-latest",
+            input=message,
+        )
+        result = response.results[0]
+        categories = getattr(result, "categories", {})
+        category_scores = getattr(result, "category_scores", {})
+        results.append(

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"

+
+
+def moderate_text(text: str, model: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("text must be a string")
+    if not text.strip():
+        raise ValueError("text must not be empty")
+
+    key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload = {"input": text}
+    if model:
+        payload["model"] = model
+    else:
+        payload["model"] = OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    results = data.get("results") or []
+    if not results:
+        return {
+            "flagged": False,
+            "categories": {},

+            "raw": data,
+        }
+
